vertebrae.execution.base
========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.execution.base

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Execution backend protocol.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.execution.base.ExecutionBackend


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: ExecutionBackend

   Bases: :py:obj:`Protocol`


   Protocol for local or future distributed execution backends.


   .. py:method:: submit(fn, job)

      Submit a single job.

      :param fn: Callable to execute.
      :param job: Job input.

      :returns: Backend-specific job handle.



   .. py:method:: gather(handles)

      Collect submitted job results.

      :param handles: Backend-specific job handles.

      :returns: Results in handle order.



   .. py:method:: status(handle)

      Return a backend-specific job status string.

      :param handle: Backend-specific job handle.

      :returns: Status string such as `"finished"` or `"running"`.



   .. py:method:: map(fn, jobs)

      Map a callable over jobs.

      :param fn: Callable to execute.
      :param jobs: Iterable of job inputs.

      :returns: Results in job order.
